contact.heading: How to place an order

feedback.heading: Tell us how we did
feedback.body: If a fitting was wrong, a delivery was late, or you have an idea for us — message us. We read every one ourselves and reply the same day.
feedback.prefill: Hello Little Princess Designer, I have feedback for you:

steps.title: Confirm on WhatsApp
steps.body: We confirm every design over WhatsApp before we begin manufacturing.

steps.title: Pay 25% advance
steps.body: A 25% advance starts production. Non-refundable once we cut. Delivery is charged separately.

steps.title: We make it just for you
steps.body: Cut and hand-finished to your measurements. We message you the day it ships.

contact.intro: Ordering handmade kidswear from Little Princess Designer takes three steps and one WhatsApp conversation. Made-to-order pieces are cut to your child's measurements; ready-to-wear pieces ship the same day.

facebook.description: See our latest posts on LittlePrincessDesigner

google.description: See our reviews and find us on Google

email.description: Ask for more information at info@littleprincessdesigner.pk

faq.question: How long does a made-to-order dress take?
faq.answer: Around three weeks from the day the 25% advance is paid. You will be updated via WhatsApp.

faq.question: Do you offer ready-to-wear options?
faq.answer: Yes. Our Ready to wear rail is already stitched in standard sizes, made to the same standard quality, lower price and dispatched as soon as you place the order.

faq.question: What sizes are available?
faq.answer: Ranges from 0–3 years up to 13–16 years, and the price shown updates with the size you pick. Made-to-order pieces are cut to your child's body, waist and length measurements.

faq.question: Do you ship outside Lahore and Pakistan?
faq.answer: We ship nationwide across Pakistan and internationally as well. Delivery is charged separately from the prices shown. We will quote the courier charges according to your city or district.
